steps.what: Find and assess actual cardiac history, results, medicines and allergies
Choose appropriate heart medication, dose, route and schedule for the actual patient
Enter the actual heart medication prescription in the clinical prescribing system {OTHER}
inputs: actual patient and medicine catalogue references

steps.what: Review actual interaction, contraindication, dose and duplicate warnings and resolve concerns
Check the final prescription, patient, dose, schedule and actual dispensing destination
Issue the checked final heart medication prescription to the actual dispensing destination
Explain actual heart medication instructions and answer patient questions

tasks.design: Configure native patient-context views and verified patient/product reference fields in the clinical prescribing system {OTHER}. The cardiologist chooses the medicine, resolves actual warnings, checks the exact final prescription and dispensing destination, issues it and explains it personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prescribing can repeat context finding and patient/product field entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and reference fields can reduce that repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Cardiac risks, dose selection, patient circumstances and warning interpretation need clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The cardiologist recognises when a standard medicine or dose is unsuitable for this patient.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated prescribing entry; prescribing rights and responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: G-Standaard supports interaction, contraindication, dose and duplicate checks; this is existing surveillance capability, not automated prescribing or a new runtime saving.

assumptions: Boundary is actual prescribing and explanation, not medicine dispensing or administration. Existing system recording of an issued prescription is runtime and has no avoided labour claim.

Patient and clinical records supply actual identity, current medicines, allergies and test results; catalogue owner supplies actual medicine identifier, form and strength. Cardiologist verifies sources in s1, chooses dose and schedule in s2 and manually completes unsupported fields in s3. No medicine choice is generated from a catalogue match.

Test native views and reference fields before code. Already-populated prescription fields and existing medication-check runtime earn no saving. All source reading, choices, warnings review and patient discussion stay human.
Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. Issuing the prescription retains its one percent share and is gated after the exact final version exists.
unknowns: What context lookup and prescription fields remain repeated?
What actual prescribing-system permissions and workflows apply?
research_questions: Can native field reuse remove repeated entry while preserving all medication and patient checks?

incremental.description: Maintain prescribing-context views and verified reference-field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final heart medication prescription including exact patient, medicine, dose, route, schedule and dispensing destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.20 finding + 14*0.20 repeated fields = 5.8; subtract 0.5 upkeep = 5.3. If half of lookup and fields are eligible, 2.9 minus 0.5 = 2.4. All clinical and issue time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise or train cardiology technologists and students.

steps.what: Prepare and check actual cardiology teaching examples or supervision instructions
inputs: actual approved cardiology examples and procedures

steps.what: Save the checked cardiology instruction material version
Supervise or train actual cardiology technologists or students and observe their work
outputs: actual cardiology supervision and learning observations

steps.what: Assess actual performance and write and check supervision feedback and outcomes
inputs: actual cardiology supervision and learning observations
outputs: checked final cardiology supervision feedback record

steps.what: Save the checked actual cardiology supervision feedback record
inputs: checked final cardiology supervision feedback record
outputs: saved actual cardiology supervision feedback record

tasks.design: Reuse actual approved example references and instruction headings in {DOCS}. The cardiologist chooses relevant material, teaches or supervises actual work and records real feedback afterward; only repeated preparation fields and unchanged example assembly change.
tasks.previous_blocker: New or revised instruction material can repeat references and example assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and linked approved examples can reduce that repeated preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical technique, safe supervision and judging a learner's understanding require direct observation.
tasks.human_edge: The cardiologist notices an unsafe inference and gives immediate clinical feedback.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated material assembly; supervision and assessment authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved example references and native document templates can support teaching preparation; clinical supervision and assessment remain human.

assumptions: Teaching and supervision are alternative branches. Boundary includes actual preparation and existing feedback records; unchanged existing courses and routine supervision have no new per-session preparation baseline. Reweight to actual work and count course-level preparation once.

Trainer supplies actual learning need and selects approved, appropriately de-identified example revision in s1. Missing or unsuitable examples stay manual. Actual learner work and observations arise in s3 before s4 records outcomes; no completion is inferred from material availability.

Test native templates and example links before code. Existing reusable material earns no saving. Actual teaching, clinical supervision, performance judgement and feedback writing remain fully retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Each save retains one percent and uses an existing material or feedback check without added approval time.
unknowns: What material is actually prepared or revised?
Which actual feedback records are maintained?
research_questions: Is repeated example assembly large enough to justify configuration after existing course reuse is counted?

approvals.approved_version: s1 checked final cardiology instruction material and exact document destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final actual cardiology supervision feedback record and exact learner or supervision destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 14*0.20 repeated preparation = 2.8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 2.3. If half the references/examples are reusable, 1.4 minus 0.5 = 0.9. Supervision, teaching and actual feedback remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss patients with physicians to create treatment plans.

steps.what: Find and assess actual patient results, history and existing treatment information
inputs: actual patient record and test results

steps.what: Talk to other physicians about actual patients and agree a treatment plan
outputs: actual agreed treatment plan and unresolved points

steps.what: Write and check the actual agreed treatment plan in the clinical record system {OTHER}
inputs: actual agreed treatment plan and unresolved points

loop.purpose: Draft a record of an actual physician-agreed treatment plan
loop.input: Cardiologist-captured agreement, actual patient context and unresolved points
loop.check: Cardiologist checks actual agreement, attribution, omitted disagreement, changed clinical meaning and unsupported treatment commitments
loop.stop: Missing actual agreement or one failed correction returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native patient fields and plan headings come first; varied inter-physician plans require bounded prose

steps.what: Commit the checked actual agreed treatment-plan record

tasks.design: Configure native patient-context views in the clinical record system {OTHER}, then use a bounded record draft from actual physician agreements. The cardiologist still reads the evidence and talks to colleagues, captures actual decisions and checks the exact final plan record before committing it; no draft creates a treatment agreement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment discussions can repeat patient-context finding and plan-note writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and bounded actual-agreement drafting can reduce lookup and first-draft record prose.
tasks.still_hard: Treatment trade-offs, different specialists' views and unresolved clinical issues require direct physician judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The cardiologist recognises a disagreement that a fluent summary might hide.
tasks.altitude: Less context and note preparation; inter-physician treatment decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native patient views and bounded clinician-captured plan drafting can support documentation of actual physician discussions; this does not generate clinical agreement.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual physician discussion and its existing treatment-plan record. Other physicians' time is outside the cardiologist denominator; prescribing, orders and external referrals are actual separate actions with no saved labour claimed here.

Patient record supplies actual identity, results and source versions. Cardiologist verifies context in s1 and captures actual physician agreement and unresolved points through actual note entry or dictation in s3 after s2. Source capture, corrections and complete final checking are counted in retained s3 time; no free transcript is assumed.

Test native views and plan headings before code. Existing context retrieval earns no saving. All clinical reading and physician discussion remain human; the model only drafts the actual recorded plan.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Final commit retains one percent and uses the existing plan-note check without added approval time.
unknowns: How much patient context finding is repeated?
What actual plan-record ownership and confirmation process applies?
research_questions: Does drafting reduce plan-note work after agreement, attribution and unresolved-point checks?

already_counted.description: Capture actual agreement and correct plan-note meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain patient-context and plan-record drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual agreed treatment-plan record and exact patient destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 lookup + 19*0.30 note prose = 9.7; subtract 1 upkeep = 8.7. If half the lookup and prose are eligible, 4.85 minus 1 = 3.85. Clinical discussion, actual agreement and commit time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Cardiac prescribing, supervision and treatment planning stay with the cardiologist while repeated context and documentation work can shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Clinical decision rights stay unchanged; validate reduced documentation effort on actual cardiac care.
